descriptions.text: Goblin Dynamite. This stuff is especially volatile. It’s so volatile, you probably don’t even need to light the wick to set it off. It’s so volatile, even loud noises might set it off. Keep it in your inventory until you’re ready to use it. Be gentle and don’t squeeze too hard or else you might get the… BOOM!

beats.headline: Sweating, then BOOM
beats.text: Carl has had five sticks since a silver goblin box. Outside a room that Donut says smells like hundreds of socks, she tells him to light a torch and throw it in. He has a better idea. The red stick is wet and sticky on the outside, as if it is sweating, and its description warns that even loud noises might set it off; the AI waits two full seconds before shouting the last word in his head. Carl lights the long wick with his Zippo, throws the stick into the room as hard as he can, and runs.

beats.headline: A few steps short
beats.text: It blows when it hits the ground, with Carl only a few steps from the door. The concussion sends him flying; he bounces and slides on the stone floor, the wooden door splinters, and a jagged hunk of it ricochets off his head. Stinking smoke pours through the entrance, blood seeps from a deep cut in his scalp, and a DANGER LOW HEALTH warning flashes red before it abates. The one throw earns him three explosives skills, a Silver Goblin Box for killing more than ten mobs with an explosive, a Gold Crowd Control Box for more than fifteen with the same attack, and an achievement for damaging a boss.

beats.headline: Loaded into a rat
beats.text: Running from Frank and Maggie, Carl tests an idea: a corpse's inventory takes items like a chest, and a lit smoke bomb stays lit inside a dead rat's grid. His goblin dynamite all reads out of fifty, every stick at Detonation Imminent or Danger, and the worst drops from ten to nine with his most careful handling. He adds that one unlit, lights one at thirteen and adds it too. If Frank loots the rat, it will literally blow up in his hands.

beats.headline: On the Maestro's show
beats.text: The Maestro's show plays the rest. Frank and Maggie were frozen in the safe room, and their teenaged daughter Yvette had been hiding under her mother's stealth field the whole time. At the rat, Maggie yells at Frank not to loot it. He does it anyway, and pulls out one item, the lit stick. He drops it in surprise and all three turn to run. The shrapnel takes Yvette down, and Frank too; a dislodged hunk of rock shears his hand right off. Carl understands that the girl's injuries were his doing.

beats.headline: Bounced back at him
beats.text: Giant zombies close in round an empty pool in the dark. Carl retracts the xistera, lights two sticks of goblin dynamite and throws one each way. The second rebounds off a shape at least twelve feet tall and rolls back toward him, hissing. He hops backward into the pool and lands on the rotting corpse of the Divider. Both sticks blow, killing most of the monsters and the last city elf, and the bloated corpse blows too, throwing him unconscious onto a roof across the street.

beats.headline: Ten sticks, one button
beats.text: The tenth and last stick of goblin dynamite goes on an exposed joist outside the building where the lich waits, fixed with a sticky detonator charge. One stick of hobgoblin pus allows up to ten simultaneous detonations with a single press. Carl hands Katia a pencil-like detonator and makes her keep it in her inventory: if they die, or if he says so, she presses the button. No questions.
